name.description: What it is called, e.g. Work.

agent.description: Which agent it is a login of. Default claude.

deleteFiles.description: Also delete its folder on disk. Default false.

agent.description: Only this agent’s accounts: claude, codex or gemini.

projectPath.description: An open folder: also say which account it would use.
An open folder. Omit for the default everywhere.

share.description: true to share, false to stop.

folder.description: An open folder to run the session in. See projects.list.

installation.description: Also read the installed CLI version without signing in or sending a model request.

sessionId.description: A session on this computer, from sessions.list.

value.description: model: a model name from agents.models, such as sonnet or opus, or "default". effort: low, medium, high, xhigh, max, ultracode, auto. fast: on, off. permission: auto, manual, acceptEdits, plan, bypass.

tool.description: Which installed tool to run. Omit to list the tools that are installed.

sessionId.description: Whose window. Omit for your own.

window.description: Window name, like B1. Omit for the first one.

limit.description: Most rows to bring back, up to 2000.

from.description: The profile whose signed-in session you are asking to have copied — its name as the person and the panel say it.

into.description: Worker names to copy it into, from browser.workers. Omit to ask for every worker.

reason.description: One line the person reads beside the ask: why you need these workers signed in. They decide on it, so say the real reason.

tool.description: For install and remove: the tool id from the list.

action.description: take: hold one worker and serve its wait before answering. release: hand it back. renew: keep it a while longer.

worker.description: The worker’s name, from browser.workers. Omit on take to be given whichever has been idle longest.

holdMs.description: How long the hold lasts before it lapses on its own. Default 120000, max 600000.

transcriptPath.description: One from chats.list. Omit for the newest.
One from chats.list. Omit for the newest.

count.description: How many rounds, newest first. Default 1, at most 10.

kind.description: Only rounds made on a device screen, or only on a browser page.

deviceId.description: The device’s id from devices.list, such as ios:… or android:….

rotate.description: Turn the device to this orientation.

to.description: A point as fractions of the screen: {"x": 0..1 from the left, "y": 0..1 from the top}.

durationMs.description: How long the finger takes, 50 to 5000. Default 300.

direction.description: Instead of from and to: the way the finger travels. up shows what is further down a list.

holdMs.description: Hold this long. 400 or more is a long press; at most 5000.

scope.description: interactive: only what can be acted on. visible (default): what is on screen. full: also what is scrolled away.

limit.description: Most elements listed. Default 150, at most 400.

deviceId.description: The device’s id from devices.list, such as ios:… or android:….

text.description: Typed into the focused field. Up to 2000 characters.

key.description: A key pressed after the text, if any.

scope.description: user: every project for this Windows user. local: one project, only this Windows user. Shared project configuration is not available.

transport.description: stdio runs a command; http/sse is a URL.

command.description: stdio: the command line that starts it, e.g. npx -y @scope/server.

arguments.description: The tool’s arguments, per its input schema.

test.description: Test a temporary connection without changing saved on/off policy or retaining a connection.

serverId.description: The id from mcp.list, like user:github.

name.description: The server as it is now.

envSet.description: Set named protected environment values, keeping other saved values hidden and unchanged.

headersSet.description: Set named protected request headers, keeping other saved values hidden and unchanged.

enabled.description: Saved on/off policy. Turning off disconnects this server.

disabledTools.description: Tool names blocked for every caller. Replaces the disabled list.

scope.description: user: every folder. project: shared in the folder’s .mcp.json. local: this folder, only you.

transport.description: stdio runs a command; http/sse is a URL.

command.description: stdio: the command line that starts it, e.g. npx -y @scope/server.

projectPath.description: The open folder, for project and local scope.

An open folder, for project-scoped installs.

deviceId.description: approve, revoke, rename and the set- verbs. From remote.status.

folders.description: approve (guest) and set-folders: absolute folders on this computer.

logins.description: Login ids, when loginShare is selected.

sessions.description: Session ids, when sessionShare is selected.

tailscale.description: Also report the optional Tailscale route. Default false.

account.description: The account to switch to, by name or id. For plan, switch, later.

key.description: Which held session, from the list. Needed for retry and forget.

cwd.description: Only sessions in this folder. Omit for all of them.

title.description: Up to 120 characters, one line. "" resets it.

sessionId.description: One session. Omit for every session, which is the overnight report.

sinceMinutes.description: Only sessions active in the last N minutes. Ignored when sessionId is given. Omit for all of them.

limit.description: How many sessions to read. Default 8, max 25.

cwd.description: An open project folder. See projects.list.

roles.description: Only these speakers. Omit for all.

projectId.description: Project id; "independent" keeps the session separate from its folder.

account.description: Login to run as, by name or id; omit for the default. It also decides the agent when provider is left out.

resume.description: Continue the folder's most recent conversation.

conversation.description: Continue exactly this conversation id instead.

brief.description: The scoped brief: repo, base branch, what to change, what counts as done, what not to touch. 40–8000 characters; needs title.

title.description: A few words naming the brief; becomes its filename.

job.description: Kind of job (playbook.read): its playbook row supplies the AI, model, effort, permission and standing instructions. Default: the title, then the default row.

differ.description: Only to differ from the playbook: {model, effort, permission (ask|plan|auto), instructions, reason}. reason is required. Bypass only comes from the playbook.

mode.description: chat: default for Claude, Codex and Gemini; supports send, wait, screen and transcript. Use terminal only when needed.

limit.description: How many messages to return, newest last. Default 40, max 200.

windowBytes.description: How many bytes from the end of the transcript to parse. Default 262144, max 4194304.

timeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait. Default 40, max 240.

after.description: The `sentAt` from sessions.send or sessions.keys. Answers older than this are not counted.

transcriptPath.description: One of that folder’s transcripts, for one session.

limit.description: How many transcripts to list. Default 20, max 100.

sessionId.description: A session from sessions.list. Omit for every login.

force.description: Ask even when the figures are recent. Default false.

display.description: Optional. A display id (as text) or name from windows.list, or "main".
